description: This file is a shell script used for testing internationalization (i18n) features in logging and commit messages within a version control system, possibly Git. It sets up different encoding scenarios, verifies log search behaviors with different encodings, and checks handling of invalid encodings.

methods.name: triggers_undefined_behaviour
methods.description: Determines if certain encoding and regex engine combinations could lead to undefined behavior during tests.

methods.name: mismatched_git_log
methods.description: Runs a git log command with specific encoding and grep pattern to test search behavior across different encodings.
